full_details: Frost was still on the yard rail. Nick read the speech once to himself and then gave it, the two lines as they were written on Wednesday. You said it was very good. He called for the Nurse, and the voice went out from under him, a crack, and a note that belongs to a man. Nobody laughed. Arthur, on a hamper, studied his nails and had nothing to add. Nick finished a third lower, without the call. He asked if the lady would be long. You told him two acts, and that she sleeps through some of it. Phillips, at the door, said to send him mornings, that it can be nursed and cannot be mended. You did not say, in the room, that you would not cut her. At the lodging door you did. You are not in the afternoon play. The word Nurse is still on the sheet.
one_sentence: Nick spoke the vial true, and the call cracked into a man's note.
title: Nick called Nurse, and the voice cracked
